hints: Focus on what reacting with oxygen means, it is oxidation, so ask which pollutants can still be oxidised further.
Consider CO and unburnt hydrocarbons, both are products of incomplete combustion and can still gain oxygen to form CO2 and water.
Think about whether NO2 is already fully oxidised, and whether nitrogen oxides are actually reduced to N2 in the converter instead.
walkthrough:
**Recall the two jobs of the converter**

A catalytic converter does both oxidation and reduction. Some pollutants are oxidised by O2, others are reduced by removing oxygen.

Think: oxidation = gain oxygen or lose electrons.

**Check CO and unburnt fuel**

CO is from incomplete combustion and is easily oxidised to harmless CO2. Unburnt fuel means hydrocarbons like octane, which are also oxidised to CO2 and water.

$$2\text{CO} + \text{O}_2 \rightarrow 2\text{CO}_2$$
$$\text{C}_8\text{H}_{18} + 12.5\text{O}_2 \rightarrow 8\text{CO}_2 + 9\text{H}_2\text{O}$$

**Check nitrogen oxides**

NO and $\text{NO}_2$ are already oxidised forms of nitrogen. In the converter they do the opposite job, they are reduced to $\text{N}_2$ by CO or hydrocarbons, not oxidised by O2.

$$2\text{NO} + 2\text{CO} \rightarrow \text{N}_2 + 2\text{CO}_2$$

**Conclude the list**

So 2 and 3 react with oxygen, but 1 does not. That combination matches 2 and 3 only.

options.A: Incorrect because it includes all three. NO2 does not react with oxygen, it is already in a high oxidation state and is removed by reduction to N2, not by further oxidation.
options.B: Incorrect because it includes NO2 with unburnt fuel but leaves out CO. CO is a classic pollutant oxidised to CO2 in the converter, while NO2 is not oxidised.
options.C: Correct because both unburnt hydrocarbons and CO are products of incomplete combustion that can be further oxidised. Hydrocarbons give CO2 + H2O and CO gives CO2, using oxygen from the air on the catalyst surface.
options.D: Incorrect because it selects only NO2. This is the opposite of what happens. Nitrogen oxides are reduced, not oxidised, so NO2 will not react with oxygen in the converter.
